fichas.title: Room Climate: Thermal Comfort, Heat Loss, and Ventilation
fichas.summary: Explains thermal comfort as a balance between body heat production and heat loss, describes bodily temperature regulation and heat exchange, and gives recommendations for room temperatures, humidity, fresh air, and ventilation. Figures show thermal comfort zones for room air, surrounding surfaces, ceiling, and floor temperatures.
